record_title: Exact finite-length optimality of uniform rank-one masks for maximal-correlation secrecy
provenance: A finite-length sharpening of the rank-constrained maximal-correlation bounds of Cohen--D'Oliveira--Sprintson, arXiv:2609.18876v1, obtained by matching their universal rank-one converse with the exact Fourier spectrum of the uniform nonzero rank-one shell.
limitations: The exact optimality theorem is proved only for rank budget one and n at least three; it does not establish the analogous statement for higher rank budgets. The finite-length improvement over the existing factor sampler vanishes exponentially with n. Uniform inputs and input-independent rank-constrained masks are retained from the converse theorem. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with elevated near-simultaneous priority risk because arXiv:2609.18876v1 is very recent.
